name: Diabolik Lovers: Moonfall
source:
The great Vampire King Karl Heinz Sakamaki found a young woman without memory of her past. He claimed that she was a vampire from a nobel family and offered her to stay with him. The young woman changed her name and country to live with the family of Karl Heinz. Many years later her now adoptiv father has a unethical request towards the woman, now named Akiza.

[From [url=https://kuroyurivn.itch.io/diabolik-lovers-moonfall]Itch.io[/url]]
